newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Goodwood Park to sell hotel - paper.
newsitem.headline: Goodwood Park to sell hotel - paper.

text.p: Goodwood Park Hotel Ltd has put up for sale its prime district Boulevard Hotel for about Singapore $560 million, The Business Times reported on Friday.
The 520-room hotel is operated by Hotel Malaysia, a listed subsidiary of main-board Goodwood Park Hotel.
The BT newspaper said a preliminary bid had been submitted by DBS Land, and another jointly by Hongkong Land and Malayan Credit.
But it said that DBS Land was believed to have entered the highest bid for the 130,000 sq ft freehold site off Orchard Road. DBS Land declined comment when contacted by Reuters.
The Business Times said the hotel had obtained provisional approval to convert the site to residential use.
Officials at Goodwood Park were unavailable for comment.
